name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the rails lightly.
Place your whole foot on each step.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A stair-climbing machine for lower-body cardio.
